description: This PHP source file defines the I18NGroupAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides an API endpoint for listing internationalization (i18n) groups, including handling of sorting and pagination parameters, and returning a collection of I18N group models.

classes.name: I18NGroupAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing I18N groups, supporting retrieval with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of I18N groups with applied sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the parameters used in the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method intended to handle creation of new I18N groups; not implemented in this class.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create method; not implemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of I18N groups; not implemented in this class.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation; not implemented.
